# PodcastFlux

> PodcastFlux (https://podcastflux.com) is a free AI Shorts maker and automatic AI clipping tool. Paste a podcast or YouTube link and the AI finds the best moments and clips them into ready vertical Shorts, Reels and TikToks with animated captions, effects and titles.

## What it does
- Automatic AI clipping: one long video or podcast becomes 3–20 Shorts, each with a viral score (0–100).
- AI speaker tracking: the 9:16 frame follows whoever is talking.
- Zero editing: the AI trims, frames, captions and titles every clip.
- Stylish auto captions: 80+ designed caption looks, key words picked out automatically.
- Keyword triggers: money, numbers, times, years, percents and feelings animate as they are said.
- Looks: Studio (video in a card, big animated words), Classic (title bar), Boxed.
- Also: AI YouTube thumbnail maker, title generator, timestamps/chapters maker.

## Pricing
- Finding and previewing clips is free; new accounts get free credits.
- A Short costs 1 credit the first time it is downloaded; a failed render refunds it.
